# Introduction

This script generates dataset for statistical analyses for ICPhS paper *Šárka Kadavá, Aleksandra Ćwiek, Katarzyna Stoltmann, Susanne Fuchs, Wim Pouw, Is gesture-speech physics at work in rhythmic pointing? Evidence from Polish counting-out rhymes, Proceedings of ICPhS.*

# Collecting datasets

In the following chunks, several datasets are being collected from the kinematic-acoustic timeseries. 
1. Peak dataset
2. Timeseries
  + movement data
  + reading condition

## 1 Peak dataset 
This dataset consist off several kinematic peaks and their relative acoustic peaks, for both finger and wrist.
The kinematic peaks are those:
* movement coordinates
* velocity
* acceleration
* deceleration

The acoustic peaks are found as relative to each of those peaks (the one that are closest in time), and includes:
* amplitude envelope
* envelope attack (slope)
* F0

*Note that we collect acoustic peaks relative to each kinematic peak, i.e., each kinematic peak has its own relative acoustic peaks*

*Also note that acoustic peaks are retrieved outside of gesture phases to ensure that we capture peaks that happens also before or after but relates to the kinematic peak of the gesture phase.*

This is a **function that generates acoustic peaks relative to respective kinematic peak**
```{r function to generate peak info, echo = TRUE, message=FALSE, warning = FALSE}

      generatesyncinfo <- function(speechpeaks_time, kinpeaks_time, speechpeak_values)
      {
        closest_peak        <- which.min(abs(speechpeaks_time-kinpeaks_time))  # smallest time difference between acoustic                                                                                and kinematic peak
        mov_sppeak        <- speechpeak_values[closest_peak]                 # nearest peak of speech peak, relative to                                                                                 kinpeak
        mov_sppeak_t      <- speechpeaks_time[closest_peak]                       # time of the speech peak
        mov_speech_sync   <- kinpeaks_time - mov_sppeak_t            # difference between timing of acoustic and                                                                              kinematic peak (i.e. synchrony)
        results <- c(closest_peak, mov_sppeak, mov_sppeak_t, mov_speech_sync)
        return(results)
      }

# the function returns matrix of 4 values
      ## [1] index of acoustic peak that is closest to the kinematic peak in time 
      ## [2] value of the acoustic peak
      ## [3] time of the acoustic peak
      ## [4] what is the time difference between acoustic and kinematic peak, i.e., synchrony
          ## when synchrony + -> acoustic peak preceeds kinematic peak
          ## when synchrony - -> acoustic peak follows kinematic peak

```

This chunk generates the dataset by looping over individual files and gesture phases
```{r dataset kinematics and peaks for finger and wrist, echo = TRUE, message=FALSE, warning = FALSE}

############# variables ###############
## these are the variables and matrices we are going to collect in the loop

f_movpeak <- f_movpeak_t <- f_velpeak <- f_velpeak_t <- f_accpeak <- f_accpeak_t <- f_decpeak <- f_decpeak_t <- f_envmov <- f_attmov <- f_f0mov <- fmov_f0_envpeak <- f_envvel <- f_attvel <- f_f0vel <- fvel_f0_envpeak <- f_envacc <- f_attacc <- f_f0acc <- facc_f0_envpeak <- f_envdec <- f_attdec <- f_f0dec <- fdec_f0_envpeak <- w_movpeak <- w_movpeak_t <- w_velpeak <- w_velpeak_t <- w_accpeak <- w_accpeak_t <- w_decpeak <- w_decpeak_t <- w_envmov <- w_attmov <- w_f0mov <- wmov_f0_envpeak <- w_envvel <- w_attvel <- w_f0vel <- wvel_f0_envpeak <- w_envacc <- w_attacc <- w_f0acc <- wacc_f0_envpeak <- w_envdec <- w_attdec <- w_f0dec <- wdec_f0_envpeak <- syllab_env_num <- numeric()

spkr <- hnd <- sp_rt <- drctn <- rhm <- syllab_env <- character()

## there are the variables that we want to have ina dataset
fing_mpeak <- fing_mpeak_time <- fing_vpeak <- fing_vpeak_time <- fing_apeak <- fing_apeak_time <- fing_envpeak_acc <- fing_envpeak_acc_time <- fing_accenv_sync <- fing_attpeak_acc <- fing_attpeak_acc_time <- fing_accatt_sync <- fing_f0peak_acc <- fing_f0peak_acc_time <- fing_accf0_sync <- fing_decpeak <- fing_decpeak_time <- fing_envpeak_dec <- fing_envpeak_dec_time <- fing_decenv_sync <- fing_attpeak_dec <- fing_attpeak_dec_time <- fing_decatt_sync <- wrist_mpeak <- wrist_mpeak_time <- wrist_vpeak <- wrist_vpeak_time <- wrist_apeak <- wrist_apeak_time <- wrist_envpeak_acc <- wrist_envpeak_acc_time <- wrist_accenv_sync <- wrist_attpeak_acc <- wrist_attpeak_acc_time <- wrist_accatt_sync <- wrist_decpeak <- wrist_decpeak_time <- wrist_envpeak_dec <- wrist_envpeak_dec_time <- wrist_decenv_sync <- wrist_attpeak_dec <- wrist_attpeak_dec_time <- wrist_decatt_sync <- fing_f0peak <- fing_f0peak_time <- fing_accf0_sync <-  fing_f0peak_dec <- fing_f0peak_dec_time <- fing_decf0_sync <- wrist_f0peak_acc <- wrist_f0peak_acc_time <- wrist_accf0_sync <- wrist_f0peak_dec <- wrist_f0peak_dec_time <- wrist_decf0_sync <- fing_envpeak_m <- fing_envpeak_m_time <- fing_movenv_sync <- fing_attpeak_m <- fing_attpeak_m_time <- fing_movatt_sync <- fing_f0peak_m <- fing_f0peak_m_time <- fing_movf0_sync <- fing_envpeak_vel <- fing_envpeak_vel_time <- fing_velenv_sync <- fing_attpeak_vel <- fing_attpeak_vel_time <- fing_velatt_sync <- fing_f0peak_vel <- fing_f0peak_vel_time <-  fing_velf0_sync <- wrist_envpeak_m <- wrist_envpeak_m_time <- wrist_movenv_sync <- wrist_attpeak_m <- wrist_attpeak_m_time <- wrist_movatt_sync <- wrist_f0peak_m <- wrist_f0peak_m_time <- wrist_movf0_sync <- wrist_envpeak_vel <- wrist_envpeak_vel_time <- wrist_velenv_sync <- wrist_attpeak_vel <- wrist_attpeak_vel_time <- wrist_velatt_sync <- wrist_f0peak_vel <- wrist_f0peak_vel_time <-  wrist_velf0_sync <- wrist_f0_accenvpeak <- wrist_f0_decenvpeak <- wrist_f0_movenvpeak <- wrist_f0_velenvpeak <- fing_f0_movenvpeak <- fing_f0_velenvpeak <- fing_f0_accenvpeak <- fing_f0_decenvpeak <-env_syllable_num <- numeric()

speaker <- point_hand <- sp_rate <- rhyme <- point_direct <- env_syllable <- character()

########## collecting peaks ###############

### looping over individual files

merged_files <- list.files(datamerged, pattern = "*.csv") # list of files from the environment

for(f in merged_files){
  mf <- read.csv(paste0(datamerged, f))
  mf$condition_speech <- as.factor(mf$condition_speech) 

  if(unique(mf$condition_speech) == "motion_speech"){ # loop only through motion + speech files (not reading)

# matrix of acoustic peaks within trials, looping outside of gesture phases because acoustic peak might follow just after (or before)
        
    # amplitude envelope peaks
    envpeakob         <- findpeaks(mf$env, minpeakheight = mean(mf$env)-(1*sd(mf$env))) 
    # findpeaks creates matrix with column 1 = value, column 2 = index
    envpeaks_indices  <- envpeakob[,2] 
    envpeaks_values   <- envpeakob[,1]
    envpeaks_time     <- mf$time_ms[envpeaks_indices]
    
    #f0peaks values at envpeak (if f0 = 0 in envpeak, it's not envpeak)
    F0_envpeaks       <- mf$F0[envpeaks_indices] 
    
    # attack (slope of amplitude envelope) peaks
    attpeakob         <- findpeaks(c(0, diff(mf$env)), minpeakheight = 0) 
    attpeaks_indices  <- attpeakob[,2]
    attpeaks_values   <- attpeakob[,1]
    attpeaks_time     <- mf$time_ms[attpeaks_indices]
    
    # f0 peaks
    f0peaksob         <- findpeaks(mf$F0, minpeakheight = mean(mf$F0)-(1*sd(mf$F0)))
    f0peaks_indices   <- f0peaksob[,2]
    f0peaks_values    <- f0peaksob[,1]
    f0peaks_time      <- mf$time_ms[f0peaks_indices]
    
    # center the movement so we can differentiate between - a + values when looking for peaks
    mf$cntr_mov_f       <- mf$z_fing - mean(mf$z_fing)
    mf$cntr_mov_w       <- mf$z_wrist - mean(mf$z_wrist)
    
    ### gesture-phase looping
    
    gesture_phs  <- unique(na.omit(mf$gesture_phases)) 

    for(phase in gesture_phs)
      {
      submf <- mf[mf$gesture_phases == phase, ] #select a portion of the merged time series
      submf <- na.trim(submf) #because there are NA's at the beginning of phases we ignore NA' selected values
      
      # Collect one value for this iteration
      
      ###### FINGER
      # 1 MOVEMENT
      ## if the movement is forward look for max value, 
      if(unique(submf$movementdirection) == 'forward_movement'){f_movpeak   <- max(submf$cntr_mov_f)}
      # if the movement is backward, look for min value
      if(unique(submf$movementdirection) == 'backward_movement'){f_movpeak  <- min(submf$cntr_mov_f)}
      
      ## time of the peak accordingly
      if(unique(submf$movementdirection) == 'forward_movement'){f_movpeak_t <- submf$time_ms[which.max(submf$cntr_mov_f)]}
      if(unique(submf$movementdirection) == 'backward_movement'){f_movpeak_t <- submf$time_ms[which.min(submf$cntr_mov_f)]}
      
      # 1.1  synchrony information finger movement and envelope amplitude
      f_envmov          <- generatesyncinfo(envpeaks_time, f_movpeak_t, envpeaks_values)
      # this function generates 4 values
        ## [1] index of acoustic peak that is closest to the kinematic peak in time 
        ## [2] value of the acoustic peak
        ## [3] time of the acoustic peak
        ## [4] what is the time difference between acoustic and kinematic peak, i.e., synchrony
      
      # what is the value of f0 in the env peak? (if 0, later omitted)
      fmov_f0_envpeak   <- F0_envpeaks[f_envmov[1]] # indexing closest timing

      #1.2. generate synchrony information finger movement and envelope amplitude (slope)
      f_attmov          <- generatesyncinfo(attpeaks_time, f_movpeak_t, attpeaks_values)
      
      #1.3. generate synchrony information finger movement and F0
      f_f0mov           <- generatesyncinfo(f0peaks_time, f_movpeak_t, f0peaks_values)
      
      #2 VELOCITY
      f_velpeak         <- max(submf$speed_fing)
      f_velpeak_t       <- submf$time_ms[which.max(submf$speed_fing)]
      
      #2.1. generate synchrony information finger velocity and envelope
      f_envvel          <- generatesyncinfo(envpeaks_time, f_velpeak_t, envpeaks_values)
      
      # what is the value of f0 in the env peak? (if 0, later omitted)
      fvel_f0_envpeak   <- F0_envpeaks[f_envvel[1]] 
      
      ## 2.2 generate synchrony information finger velocity and attack
      f_attvel          <- generatesyncinfo(attpeaks_time, f_velpeak_t, attpeaks_values)
      
      ## 2.3. generate synchrony information finger velocity and F0
      f_f0vel           <- generatesyncinfo(f0peaks_time, f_velpeak_t, f0peaks_values)
      
      # 3 ACCELERATION 
      f_accpeak         <- max(submf$acc_fing) 
      f_accpeak_t       <- submf$time_ms[which.max(submf$acc_fing)]
      
      ## 3.1. generate synchrony information finger acceleration and envelope
      f_envacc          <- generatesyncinfo(envpeaks_time, f_accpeak_t, envpeaks_values)
      
      # what is the value of f0 in the env peak? (if 0, later omitted)
      facc_f0_envpeak   <- F0_envpeaks[f_envacc[1]] 
      
      ## 3.2. generate synchrony information finger acceleration and envelope attack
      f_attacc          <- generatesyncinfo(attpeaks_time, f_accpeak_t, attpeaks_values)
      
      ## 3.3. generate synchrony information finger acceleration and F0
      f_f0acc           <- generatesyncinfo(f0peaks_time, f_accpeak_t, f0peaks_values)
      
      # 4 DECELERATION 
      f_decpeak         <- min(submf$acc_fing) 
      f_decpeak_t       <- submf$time_ms[which.min(submf$acc_fing)]
      
      ## 4.1. generate synchrony information finger deceleration and envelope
      f_envdec          <- generatesyncinfo(envpeaks_time, f_decpeak_t, envpeaks_values)
      
      # what is the value of f0 in the env peak? (if 0, later omitted)
      fdec_f0_envpeak   <- F0_envpeaks[f_envdec[1]] 
      
      ## 4.2. generate synchrony information finger deceleration and envelope attack
      f_attdec          <- generatesyncinfo(attpeaks_time, f_decpeak_t, attpeaks_values)
      
      ## 4.3. generate synchrony information finger deceleration and F0
      f_f0dec           <- generatesyncinfo(f0peaks_time, f_decpeak_t, f0peaks_values)
      
      ########### WRIST
      #1 MOVEMENT COORDINATES
      # if the movement is forward, take the maximum value,
      if(unique(submf$movementdirection) == 'forward_movement'){w_movpeak <- max(submf$cntr_mov_w)}
      if(unique(submf$movementdirection) == 'backward_movement'){w_movpeak <- min(submf$cntr_mov_w)}
      
      # if the movement is backward, take the minimum value
      if(unique(submf$movementdirection) == 'forward_movement'){w_movpeak_t <- submf$time_ms[which.max(submf$cntr_mov_w)]}
      if(unique(submf$movementdirection) == 'backward_movement'){w_movpeak_t <- submf$time_ms[which.min(submf$cntr_mov_w)]}
      
      ## 1.1. generate information for movement and envelope
      w_envmov          <- generatesyncinfo(envpeaks_time, w_movpeak_t, envpeaks_values)
      # what is the value of f0 when envpeak happens
      wmov_f0_envpeak   <- F0_envpeaks[w_envmov[1]] 
      
      ## 1.2. generate information for movement and envelope attack
      w_attmov          <- generatesyncinfo(attpeaks_time, w_movpeak_t, attpeaks_values)
    
      ## 1.3. generate information for movement and F0
      w_f0mov           <- generatesyncinfo(f0peaks_time, w_movpeak_t, f0peaks_values)
  
      #2 VELOCITY
      w_velpeak         <- max(submf$speed_wrist)
      w_velpeak_t       <- submf$time_ms[which.max(submf$speed_wrist)]
      
      ## 2.1. generate information for velocity and envelope
      w_envvel          <- generatesyncinfo(envpeaks_time, w_velpeak_t, envpeaks_values)
      # what is the value of f0 when envpeak happens
      wvel_f0_envpeak   <- F0_envpeaks[w_envvel[1]] 
      
      ## 2.2. generate information for velocity and envelope attack
      w_attvel          <- generatesyncinfo(attpeaks_time, w_velpeak_t, attpeaks_values)
      
      ## 2.2. generate information for velocity and f0
      w_f0vel           <- generatesyncinfo(f0peaks_time, w_velpeak_t, f0peaks_values)
      
      #3 ACCELERATION 
      w_accpeak         <- max(submf$acc_wrist) 
      w_accpeak_t       <- submf$time_ms[which.max(submf$acc_wrist)] 
      
      ## 3.1. generate information for acceleration and envelope 
      w_envacc          <- generatesyncinfo(envpeaks_time, w_accpeak_t, envpeaks_values)
      # what is the value of f0 in the env peak? (if 0, later omitted)
      wacc_f0_envpeak   <- F0_envpeaks[w_envacc[1]] 
      
      ## 3.2. generate information for acceleration and envelope attack
      w_attacc          <- generatesyncinfo(attpeaks_time, w_accpeak_t, attpeaks_values)
      
      ## 3.3. generate information for acceleration and F0
      w_f0acc           <- generatesyncinfo(f0peaks_time, w_accpeak_t, f0peaks_values)
     
      #4 DECELERATION
      w_decpeak         <- min(submf$acc_wrist) 
      w_decpeak_t       <- submf$time_ms[which.min(submf$acc_wrist)]
     
      ## 4.1. generate information for deceleration and envelope
      w_envdec          <- generatesyncinfo(envpeaks_time, w_decpeak_t, envpeaks_values)
      # what is the value of f0 in the env peak? (if 0, later omitted)
      wdec_f0_envpeak   <- F0_envpeaks[w_envdec[1]] 
      
      ## 4.2. generate information for deceleration and envelope attack
      w_attdec          <- generatesyncinfo(attpeaks_time, w_decpeak_t, attpeaks_values)
     
      ## 4.3. generate information for deceleration and F0
      w_f0dec           <- generatesyncinfo(f0peaks_time, w_decpeak_t, f0peaks_values)
     
      # METADATA
      spkr              <- unique(submf$participant) # speaker
      hnd               <- unique(submf$hand) # hand
      sp_rt             <- unique(submf$speed_condition) # speed condition
      drctn             <- unique(submf$movementdirection) # direction of movement
      rhm               <- unique(submf$rhyme_name) # name of rhyme
      syllab_env        <- submf$syllable[w_envacc[1]] # syllable in the envelope peak (later omitted those peaks with syllable = pause)
    
  ##########
  ### save the observations for this iteration
     
      #### finger
      ## naming convention: limb_peak
      ## m = movement; env = envelope; att = attack; a/acc = acceleration; dec = deceleration; v/vel = velocity
      
      fing_mpeak                <- c(fing_mpeak, f_movpeak) 
      fing_mpeak_time           <- c(fing_mpeak_time, f_movpeak_t) 
      
      fing_envpeak_m            <- c(fing_envpeak_m, f_envmov[2]) # indexed from the function results
      fing_envpeak_m_time       <- c(fing_envpeak_m_time, f_envmov[3])
      fing_movenv_sync          <- c(fing_movenv_sync, f_envmov[4])
      fing_f0_movenvpeak        <- c(fing_f0_movenvpeak, fmov_f0_envpeak)

      fing_attpeak_m            <- c(fing_attpeak_m, f_attmov[2]) 
      fing_attpeak_m_time       <- c(fing_attpeak_m_time, f_attmov[3]) 
      fing_movatt_sync          <- c(fing_movatt_sync, f_attmov[4]) 
      
      fing_f0peak_m             <- c(fing_f0peak_m, f_f0mov[2]) 
      fing_f0peak_m_time        <- c(fing_f0peak_m_time, f_f0mov[3])
      fing_movf0_sync           <- c(fing_movf0_sync, f_f0mov[4])
      
      fing_vpeak                <- c(fing_vpeak, f_velpeak)
      fing_vpeak_time           <- c(fing_vpeak_time, f_velpeak_t)
      
      fing_envpeak_vel          <- c(fing_envpeak_vel, f_envvel[2])
      fing_envpeak_vel_time     <- c(fing_envpeak_vel_time, f_envvel[3])
      fing_velenv_sync          <- c(fing_velenv_sync, f_envvel[4])
      fing_f0_velenvpeak        <- c(fing_f0_velenvpeak, fvel_f0_envpeak)
      
      fing_attpeak_vel          <- c(fing_attpeak_vel, f_attvel[2]) 
      fing_attpeak_vel_time     <- c(fing_attpeak_vel_time, f_attvel[3]) 
      fing_velatt_sync          <- c(fing_velatt_sync, f_attvel[4]) 
      
      fing_f0peak_vel           <- c(fing_f0peak_vel, f_f0vel[2]) 
      fing_f0peak_vel_time      <- c(fing_f0peak_vel_time, f_f0vel[3]) 
      fing_velf0_sync           <- c(fing_velf0_sync, f_f0vel[4])
      
      fing_apeak                <- c(fing_apeak, f_accpeak)
      fing_apeak_time           <- c(fing_apeak_time, f_accpeak_t)
      
      fing_envpeak_acc          <- c(fing_envpeak_acc, f_envacc[2])
      fing_envpeak_acc_time     <- c(fing_envpeak_acc_time, f_envacc[3])
      fing_accenv_sync          <- c(fing_accenv_sync, f_envacc[4])
      fing_f0_accenvpeak        <- c(fing_f0_accenvpeak, facc_f0_envpeak)
      
      fing_attpeak_acc          <- c(fing_attpeak_acc, f_attacc[2])
      fing_attpeak_acc_time     <- c(fing_attpeak_acc_time, f_attacc[3])
      fing_accatt_sync          <- c(fing_accatt_sync, f_attacc[4])

      fing_f0peak_acc           <- c(fing_f0peak_acc, f_f0acc[2]) 
      fing_f0peak_acc_time      <- c(fing_f0peak_acc_time, f_f0acc[3]) 
      fing_accf0_sync           <- c(fing_accf0_sync, f_f0acc[4])
      
      fing_decpeak              <- c(fing_decpeak, f_decpeak)
      fing_decpeak_time         <- c(fing_decpeak_time, f_decpeak_t)
      
      fing_envpeak_dec          <- c(fing_envpeak_dec, f_envdec[2])
      fing_envpeak_dec_time     <- c(fing_envpeak_dec_time, f_envdec[3])
      fing_decenv_sync          <- c(fing_decenv_sync, f_envdec[4])
      fing_f0_decenvpeak        <- c(fing_f0_decenvpeak, fdec_f0_envpeak)
      
      fing_attpeak_dec          <- c(fing_attpeak_dec, f_attdec[2])
      fing_attpeak_dec_time     <- c(fing_attpeak_dec_time, f_attdec[3])
      fing_decatt_sync          <- c(fing_decatt_sync, f_attdec[4])
      
      fing_f0peak_dec           <- c(fing_f0peak_dec, f_f0dec[2]) 
      fing_f0peak_dec_time      <- c(fing_f0peak_dec_time, f_f0dec[3]) 
      fing_decf0_sync           <- c(fing_decf0_sync, f_f0dec[4])
      
      ### wrist
      wrist_mpeak               <- c(wrist_mpeak, w_movpeak)
      wrist_mpeak_time          <- c(wrist_mpeak_time, w_movpeak_t)
      
      wrist_envpeak_m           <- c(wrist_envpeak_m, w_envmov[2])
      wrist_envpeak_m_time      <- c(wrist_envpeak_m_time, w_envmov[3])
      wrist_movenv_sync         <- c(wrist_movenv_sync, w_envmov[4])
      wrist_f0_movenvpeak       <- c(wrist_f0_movenvpeak, wmov_f0_envpeak)
      
      wrist_attpeak_m           <- c(wrist_attpeak_m, w_attmov[2]) 
      wrist_attpeak_m_time      <- c(wrist_attpeak_m_time, w_attmov[3]) 
      wrist_movatt_sync         <- c(wrist_movatt_sync, w_attmov[4]) 
      
      wrist_f0peak_m            <- c(wrist_f0peak_m, w_f0mov[2]) 
      wrist_f0peak_m_time       <- c(wrist_f0peak_m_time, w_f0mov[3]) 
      wrist_movf0_sync          <- c(wrist_movf0_sync, w_f0mov[4])
      
      wrist_vpeak               <- c(wrist_vpeak, w_velpeak)
      wrist_vpeak_time          <- c(wrist_vpeak_time, w_velpeak_t)
      
      wrist_envpeak_vel         <- c(wrist_envpeak_vel, w_envvel[2])
      wrist_envpeak_vel_time    <- c(wrist_envpeak_vel_time, w_envvel[3])
      wrist_velenv_sync         <- c(wrist_velenv_sync, w_envvel[4])
      wrist_f0_velenvpeak       <- c(wrist_f0_velenvpeak, wvel_f0_envpeak)
      
      wrist_attpeak_vel         <- c(wrist_attpeak_vel, w_attvel[2]) 
      wrist_attpeak_vel_time    <- c(wrist_attpeak_vel_time, w_attvel[3]) 
      wrist_velatt_sync         <- c(wrist_velatt_sync, w_attvel[4]) 
      
      wrist_f0peak_vel          <- c(wrist_f0peak_vel, w_f0vel[2]) 
      wrist_f0peak_vel_time     <- c(wrist_f0peak_vel_time, w_f0vel[3]) 
      wrist_velf0_sync          <- c(wrist_velf0_sync, w_f0vel[4])
      
      wrist_apeak               <- c(wrist_apeak, w_accpeak)
      wrist_apeak_time          <- c(wrist_apeak_time, w_accpeak_t)
      
      wrist_envpeak_acc         <- c(wrist_envpeak_acc, w_envacc[2])
      wrist_envpeak_acc_time    <- c(wrist_envpeak_acc_time, w_envacc[3])
      wrist_accenv_sync         <- c(wrist_accenv_sync, w_envacc[4])
      wrist_f0_accenvpeak       <- c(wrist_f0_accenvpeak, wacc_f0_envpeak) 
      
      wrist_attpeak_acc         <- c(wrist_attpeak_acc, w_attacc[2])

      wrist_envpeak_dec         <- c(wrist_envpeak_dec, w_envdec[2])
      wrist_envpeak_dec_time    <- c(wrist_envpeak_dec_time, w_envdec[3])
      wrist_decenv_sync         <- c(wrist_decenv_sync, w_envdec[4])

      wrist_attpeak_dec         <- c(wrist_attpeak_dec, w_attdec[2])
      wrist_attpeak_dec_time    <- c(wrist_attpeak_dec_time, w_attdec[3])
      wrist_decatt_sync         <- c(wrist_decatt_sync, w_attdec[4])
      
      wrist_f0peak_dec          <- c(wrist_f0peak_dec, w_f0dec[2]) 
      wrist_f0peak_dec_time     <- c(wrist_f0peak_dec_time, w_f0dec[3]) 
      wrist_decf0_sync          <- c(wrist_decf0_sync, w_f0dec[4])
      
      speaker                   <- c(speaker, spkr)
      point_hand                <- c(point_hand, hnd)
      sp_rate                   <- c(sp_rate, sp_rt)
      point_direct              <- c(point_direct, drctn)
      rhyme                     <- c(rhyme, rhm)
      env_syllable              <- c(env_syllable, syllab_env)
      env_syllable_num          <- c(env_syllable_num, syllab_env_num)
      
      
    }
  }
}
```

## Time series dataset

Next two chunks generate data for the whole **time series**. They are useful mainly for plotting. 

### Time series: movement
```{r dataset time series movement, echo = TRUE, message=FALSE, warning = FALSE}

########## variables ###############
# these are the variables that we want to have in a dataset

time_ms <- ts_time <- fing <- fing_a <- wrist <- wrist_a <- elbow <- elbow_a <- envelope <- m_fing <- a_fing <- m_wrist <- a_wrist <- m_elb <- a_elb <- env <- env_att <- attack <- f0 <- freq <- syll_num <- syllable_num <- numeric()

participant <- hand <- rhyme <- rate <- speaker <- point_hand <- rhyme_name <- speech_rate <- speech <- is_speech <- syll <- syllable <- character()

########## collecting datapoints ############

## looping over individual files

merged_files <- list.files(datamerged, pattern = "*.csv") # link it to the files from the environment

for(f in merged_files){
  mf <- read.csv(paste0(datamerged, f))
  mf$condition_speech <- as.factor(mf$condition_speech)

  if(unique(mf$condition_speech) == "motion_speech"){ # we only want timeseries from movement condition
    
    # Collect one value for this iteration
                          
      fing          <- mf$z_fing # z-dimension of finger movement
      fing_a        <- mf$acc_fing # acceleration
      wrist         <- mf$z_wrist # z-dimension of wrist movement
      wrist_a       <- mf$acc_wrist # acceleration
      elbow         <- mf$z_elb # z-dimension of elbow movement
      elbow_a       <- mf$acc_elb
      envelope      <- mf$env # amplitude envelope
      attack        <- c(0, diff(mf$env)) # envelope attack (slope)
      freq          <- mf$F0 # fundamental frequency
      
      # metadata
      participant   <- mf$participant 
      hand          <- mf$hand
      rhyme         <- mf$rhyme_name
      rate          <- mf$speed_condition
      speech        <- mf$speech
      ts_time       <- mf$time_ms
      syll          <- mf$syllable
      syll_num      <- mf$syllable_num
      
      ######## filling up ##############
      # fill up the observations for this iteration
      m_fing            <- c(m_fing, fing)
      a_fing            <- c(a_fing, fing_a)
      m_wrist           <- c(m_wrist, wrist)
      a_wrist           <- c(a_wrist, wrist_a)
      m_elb             <- c(m_elb, elbow)
      a_elb             <- c(a_elb, elbow_a)
      env               <- c(env, envelope)
      env_att           <- c(env_att, attack)
      f0                <- c(f0, freq)
      speaker           <- c(speaker, participant)
      point_hand        <- c(point_hand, hand)
      rhyme_name        <- c(rhyme_name, rhyme)
      speech_rate       <- c(speech_rate, rate)
      is_speech         <- c(is_speech, speech)
      time_ms           <- c(time_ms, ts_time)
      syllable          <- c(syllable, syll)
      syllable_num      <- c(syllable_num, syll_num)
      
}}
  
############## datasets #############    
#this is a dataset containing time_series of all trials

dataset_ts <- cbind.data.frame(speaker, rhyme_name, syllable, syllable_num, point_hand, speech_rate, time_ms, m_fing, a_fing, m_wrist, a_wrist, m_elb, a_elb, env, env_att, f0, is_speech)

dataset_ts <- subset(dataset_ts, is_speech == "ongoing speech") # keep only timeseries within ongoing speech

```

### Time series: reading condition
```{r time series for reading, echo = TRUE, message=FALSE, warning = FALSE}

########### variables #############
# these are the variables that we want to have in a dataset

time_ms <- ts_time <- envelope <- env <- env_att <- attack <- f0 <- freq <- syll_num <- syllable_num <- numeric()

participant <- rhyme <- speaker <- rhyme_name <- syll <- syllable <- character()

############## collecting datapoints ##############
## looping over individual files

merged_files <- list.files(datamerged, pattern = "*.csv") # link to the files in the environment

for(f in merged_files){
  mf <- read.csv(paste0(datamerged, f))
  mf$condition_speech <- as.factor(mf$condition_speech)

  if(unique(mf$condition_speech) == "lesen"){ # now we are interested only in reading condition
    
    # Collect one value for this iteration
     
      envelope      <- mf$env # amplitude envelope
      attack        <- c(0, diff(mf$env)) # envelope attack (slope)
      freq          <- mf$F0 # fundamental frequency
      
      # metadata
      participant   <- mf$participant 
      rhyme         <- mf$rhyme_name
      ts_time       <- mf$time_ms
      syll          <- mf$syllable
      syll_num      <- mf$syllable_num
      
      ########## filling up ############
      #fill up the observations for this iteration
      env               <- c(env, envelope)
      env_att           <- c(env_att, attack)
      f0                <- c(f0, freq)
      speaker           <- c(speaker, participant)
      rhyme_name        <- c(rhyme_name, rhyme)
      time_ms           <- c(time_ms, ts_time)
      syllable          <- c(syllable, syll)
      syllable_num      <- c(syllable_num, syll_num)
   
  }}

########### datasets #############
      
#this is a dataset containing time_series of all trials

dataset_ts_lesen <- cbind.data.frame(speaker, rhyme_name, time_ms, syllable, syllable_num, env, env_att, f0)

# You can save the dataset to a CSV file
write.csv(dataset_ts_lesen, paste0(datasets, "dataset_ts_lesen.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```
